_doc: LSDJ kit-patching smoke test. Boots LSDJ (the cartridge self-test takes ~15s on a fresh ROM — patching before that finishes makes the self-test fail), then patches a custom drum kit (mule kick/snare/hat from resources/samples/) into kit slot 0. Two screenshots: one of the song screen right after boot, one after the patch is applied. The PROJECT screen's KIT row should show 'TEST' as the slot-0 name on the second screenshot.
